data.description: c11 resumes Codex with `codex resume --yolo <id>` (since #384), but Resources/bin/codex read the expected resume id only from $2. Every c11-driven resume was claimed as a plain launch; the store replaced the exact ref with a placeholder and the next restart skipped the tab. Codex resumed only on alternate restarts. Found 2026-10-01 after the 0.67.0 update restart: `c11 state verify --mode clean` showed the resumed Codex tab as [skip] wrapper-claim placeholder.
data.title: Codex resume drops its exact ref on every c11-driven resume

data.body: Fixed by PR #480, squash-merged as e201af7. Wrapper takes the single UUID after `resume` as intent (--last or 0/2+ UUIDs: none). Wrapper test gains rail cases and strips the -c notify= prefix (test had been failing on main). Live check vs installed 0.67.0 socket with a fake codex: old wrapper left a placeholder (can_resume false), fixed kept the exact id (can_resume true). Drawbridge deep review: merge, no blockers. Changelog line for the release: 'Codex tabs now resume on every c11 restart, not every other one.'
Drawbridge deep review on PR #480: correct, minimal, conservative; no blockers. Wrapper test passes with fix, fails on old wrapper; live socket check passes. Merged e201af7 on Atin's go.
